## About
EU Auto Group is a repair and service shop near uptown Charlotte for European and Japanese vehicles, including Mercedes, BMW, Lexus, Infiniti, Acura and high-end exotics. We serve drivers in Charlotte, Mint Hill and Matthews.
Our approach is total customer care, from towing and vehicle pickup to dropping you off, so getting your car looked after is affordable and comfortable. Our experienced and certified mechanics take care with every job.
Drivers have given us a 4.9 rating from 109 Google reviews.

## Services
- Routine maintenance and service: Regular upkeep to keep your car running the way it should.
- Manufacturer-recommended interval service: Service done on the schedule your car's maker recommends.
- Engine, transmission and drivetrain repair: Major repairs on the parts that make your car go.
- Paint and body work: Cosmetic and major paint and body work, including ding repair.
- Towing and vehicle pick-up: We can tow or pick up your car and bring it to the shop.
- Customer drop-off and pick-up: We can drop you off and pick you up while your car is with us.

## FAQ
Q: What makes do you work on?
A: We work on European and Japanese vehicles, including Mercedes, BMW, Lexus, Infiniti, Acura and high-end exotics such as Aston Martin and Jaguar.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I set up an appointment?
A: Give us a call to set up an appointment or talk through what's going on with your car. You can also email service@euautogroup.com.
